key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.72s): Initial archival pose of triangle; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.85s): Mid-sequence articulation of triangle; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=5.08s): Peak dynamic extension of triangle over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=6.32s): Follow-through and settle of triangle with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of triangle (2.72s..6.32s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
